The Meatbag Labs Territory

Games, gazettes & other claims staked by Kevin Sotka

Doc says

Well howdy, stranger. Name's Doc. I ride shotgun on this here wagon train of claims — games by the dozen, a gazette, a novel, and a whole land you can walk into. Some have struck the vein and you can stroll right in the door. Others are still gettin' hammered on, and I'll tell ya which is which straight. Go on, have a look around the territory.

Neo‑Shenzhen, 2047. The rain's got lithium in it and a fella named Marcus certifies who's still human — 'til the day he certifies somebody who ain't. Book One's got a home now; the ink's still wet.
